ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling is localized at the distal tips of both lobes, extending along the trailing edges. The central fluke body and leading edges consist of contiguous low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 68 degrees and a vertical depth of 125 pixels from the lobe peak horizontal.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge with peak-to-valley amplitudes varying between 4 and 18 pixels; most acute jaggedness is located between the mid-lobe and the central notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave sweep trajectory observed along the trailing edge from the distal tips to the median notch; leading edge exhibits a smooth convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, circular high-contrast pixel clusters detected at the far margin of the left lobe and scattered as isolated white points on the black surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel, unaligned linear dark pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible within the white mottled region of the right lobe tip, oriented diagonally to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable deep, irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the tip to the notch, distinct from standard serration frequency.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique salt-and-pepper pixel transition zones between the solid black medial area and the white distal mottling on both lobes.
